ModMetaData.name: Ancient Dangers on Campsites and Encounter maps
ModMetaData.author: VitaKaninen
ModMetaData.description:
Allows ancient dangers to spawn on campsites and encounter maps. It will also work on campsites from the [u][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3234938357]Set up Camp[/url][/u] Mod if you are on a previous version of the game.
Inspired by this mod from Luca: [u][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2910004353]Ancient dangers on encounters[/url][/u].
